findings.claim: ReportIfLocatedInCompilation drops every diagnostic whose location is not in a syntax tree of the current compilation, including diagnostics with no location (Location.None). The wrapper applies to all reportDiagnostic calls, so any diagnostic that guards users against insecure or unsupported configurations and lacks a source location is now silently suppressed instead of crashing or reporting. Because the wrapper only filters the analyzer path, the generator output does not change. The suppression could hide a security-relevant diagnostic, but none is evident in the diff, so the impact is low.

receipt_plan.detail: Add an analyzer test where a MessagePackObject has a member that triggers a diagnostic with a null or metadata location (for example MemberNeedsKey on a metadata type). Assert the diagnostic set before and after the change. Also grep reportDiagnostic call sites for any security-relevant rule that can carry Location.None.
